archetype: Performance Pro / Tech Studio (Tactical Studio Minimalism)
theme: Dark obsidian & slate studio theme with electric indigo/cyan kinetic highlights

typography.heading_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none text-slate-100
typography.heading_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
typography.font_rules: DO NOT use Inter for main hero or studio titles. Use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for headers and JetBrains Mono for action logs and timestamp badges.

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/20 transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-400
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:text-white
buttons.accent: bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-cyan-500 hover:from-indigo-400 hover:to-cyan-400 text-white font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/25 transition-all duration-200

cards.glass: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-800/80 rounded-xl p-6 shadow-2xl hover:border-slate-700/80 transition-all
cards.interactive: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-5 hover:border-indigo-500/40 hover:shadow-indigo-500/10 hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer

forms.input: bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 outline-none transition-all
forms.textarea: bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 focus:border-indigo-500 text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 rounded-lg p-4 text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/20 outline-none transition-all font-mono

component_styling.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-slate-950/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800/80 px-6 py-3.5 flex items-center justify-between

key_features_and_views.name: Auth Page
key_features_and_views.description: Split hero visual and glass login form supporting email/password authentication and Google OAuth mock button.

key_features_and_views.name: Projects Dashboard
key_features_and_views.description: Grid of created demo projects with status tags (Draft, Executing, Ready, Exported), thumbnail preview, search bar, duplicate/delete actions, and 'Create New Demo' hero CTA.

key_features_and_views.name: Draft Spec & AI Script Engine
key_features_and_views.description: Text area to paste release notes or feature specs, selector for AI persona/voice prompt, and real-time step generator converting specs into structured actions (Click, Type, Scroll, Wait).

key_features_and_views.name: Studio & Timeline Editor
key_features_and_views.description: Timeline sequence editor with visual drag-to-reorder action steps, caption text editor, voiceover synthesizer settings, Browserless live execution progress tracker with live screen simulation.

key_features_and_views.name: Export & Share Studio
key_features_and_views.description: Export settings modal offering GIF generation, MP4 video rendering, embeddable iframe snippet generator, public share URL creator, and theme customizations.

key_features_and_views.name: Public Player Page
key_features_and_views.description: Embeddable/Shareable interactive demo viewer with hotspot tooltips, audio voiceover toggle, step navigation controls, and full-screen player mode.

key_features_and_views.name: Settings Page
key_features_and_views.description: Browserless API connection options, AI Voiceover model preferences, brand assets (logos, custom player colors), and account settings.

motion_and_microinteractions.transitions: Use spring transitions for timeline cards (type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 25). Fade-in for step execution console.
motion_and_microinteractions.hover_states: Hover scale 1.02 on project cards, slight glow outline on focus, active button press scale 0.97.
motion_and_microinteractions.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by fallback to standard opacity fade without transforms.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. White/Slate-100 text over slate-900 background passes APCA/WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:outline-none) on all inputs, buttons, and timeline items.
accessibility.aria_labels: All interactive timeline controls, step player buttons, export actions must have aria-label and data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, polished AI Product Demo Builder SaaS app in React JS using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons.
Ensure standard components in src/components/ui/ are imported and customized with dark obsidian theme colors.
Implement real working mock data for draft-to-script AI breakdown, live step execution runner, timeline editing, voiceover selection, and multi-format export options.
Every key view (Auth, Projects Dashboard, New Script Creator, Studio Timeline Editor, Player Export Modal, Public Embed View, Settings) must be fully navigable and state-persistent.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, input fields, and action controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never create standard white/light grey boring dashboards. Use the dark studio obsidian palette with glowing borders.
Never use universal CSS transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.
Header must have backdrop-blur and border-b border-slate-800, never completely flat or missing.
All forms must use customized Shadcn/Tailwind components with explicit dark input styles and hover states.
Provide toast feedback using Sonner for user actions (project saved, script generated, step added, export copied).
